hannah: Postmortem follow-up: token-gap incident summary and next steps. We observed a ~90min window of missing auth events, combined with a rotation runner permission regression. Need clear owners, short deadlines, and an idempotent backfill.
hannah: High level fixes we agreed on in the postmortem:
- guardian metric + pager for rotation failures
- audit ingestion validation + backfill playbook (idempotent)
- rotation automation + permission hardening
- SLO + dashboard + monthly smoke test

hannah: Proposed owners + ETA:
- lucas -> rotation guardian exporter + prom alert (due 2026-04-04)
- nina -> audit backfill script + validation query (due 2026-04-02)
- security-eng -> runbook + SLO thresholds (due 2026-04-01)

lucas: I'll take the guardian. Plan: exporter that checks last-success timestamp and emits rotation_missed_count. Wire a page if >0 in 10m window. PR by Wed.

lucas: alert sketch:
```
# prom alert: rotation_missed
expr: increase(rotation_missed_count[10m]) > 0
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
```

nina: I'll handle backfill. Will build an idempotent ES backfill that uses event_id and a dry-run validation mode first. Need security to review fields and approval to run in prod. Targeting EOD Thu for draft.

nina: backfill plan notes:
- query window: 2026-03-28T02:00 -> 2026-03-28T03:30 UTC
- dedupe by event_id, write to staging topic, validate counts before swap
- runbook checklist: pre-backup, pre-validate, run, verify, monitor

security-eng: We'll produce the runbook and propose SLOs. Early suggestion: token-validation success >= 99.95% over 7d; page if rolling 30m drops below 99.9%. We'll include escalation matrix and who to page for backfills. Runbook draft by Tue.

pager-bot: Reminder posted: remediation sync Thursday 09:30 PT. Auto-reminder 24h before.

hannah: Please add tracker tasks and link PRs/issues here. Also I'll create a recurring 30min check-in for owners; will mark optional.

lucas: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234 12 - rotation exporter + unit tests. PTAL.

nina: Issue for backfill and sample events: https://redwood-internal/issue/6789 - includes query drafts and staging run plan.

security-eng: Runbook draft at https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/token-gap-remediation.md - will add SLO rationale and approval gate for backfills today.

hannah: A few coordination notes:
- backfill must be idempotent and run in staging first
- we should avoid immediate high-cost replays; prefer targeted window + validation queries
- owners must post a one-line closure message in this thread when done so we can close the postmortem tracker

lucas: I'll add a synthetic nightly job that does a rotation and emits a test auth event so we exercise the full path and surface ingestion problems earlier. Results will feed token_health metric.

nina: I'll include a dry-run flag on the backfill and a verification script that compares expected vs actual counts; will post results in the issue before running in prod.

security-eng: Also recommending monthly audit smoke test and adding token-health card to the ops dashboard. We'll propose exact metrics in the runbook.

hannah: If any ETA slips, call it out early here. Owners, post brief status updates in this thread as you make progress. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
